source /tmp/pb-venv/bin/activate && GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED] paperbanana generate \
  --input /tmp/pb-fig2-input.txt \
  --caption "STA overview. (a) The formalization pipeline: an LLM translates NL premises into formal logic, verified by an external solver. (b) STA removes each component in turn and re-runs the solver; the fraction of necessary components yields ISR. (c) Applied post-hoc, ISR detects structural hacking; repurposed as reward, it triggers a Goodhart effect where tautological shortcuts achieve ISR=1 by construction. Three-panel horizontal layout, professional academic style with serif fonts, limited color palette (blue=#2166AC, red=#B2182B, green=#4CAF50, gray=#636363), clean rectangular boxes, thin panel dividers, full-width figure suitable for a two-column ACL/EMNLP paper. figsize=(14, 4.2), white background, 300 DPI." \
  --output /tmp/pb-fig2-output.png \
  --vlm-model gemini-2.5-flash \
  --iterations 3 2>&1

13	RED = "#B2182B"

17	DARK = "#252525"
18	WHITE = "#FFFFFF"

20	plt.rcParams.update({
21	    "font.family": "serif",
22	    "font.serif": ["DejaVu Serif", "Times New Roman", "Times"],

30	fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.2))
31	
32	# Three panels with custom widths

44	
45	def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, fc=LIGHT_GRAY, ec=GRAY, lw=1.0,
46	        fontsize=9.5, fontweight="normal", text_color=DARK,
47	        style="round,pad=0.12", multiline=False):

50	    ax.add_patch(patch)

62	        conn="arc3,rad=0", shrA=4, shrB=4):

64	                        color=color, lw=lw, connectionstyle=conn,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Fig 2: STA Overview — professional 3-panel academic figure."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

# ── Minimal palette ──
BLUE = "#2166AC"
LIGHT_BLUE = "#D1E5F0"
RED = "#B2182B"
LIGHT_RED = "#FDDBC7"
GRAY = "#636363"
LIGHT_GRAY = "#F0F0F0"
DARK = "#252525"
WHITE = "#FFFFFF"

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["DejaVu Serif", "Times New Roman", "Times"],
    "mathtext.fontset": "dejavuserif",
    "font.size": 10,
    "axes.linewidth": 0,
    "pdf.fonttype": 42,
    "ps.fonttype": 42,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.2))

# Three panels with custom widths
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 3, width_ratios=[0.95, 1.2, 0.85],
                      wspace=0.06, left=0.02, right=0.98,
                      top=0.92, bottom=0.04)
axes = [fig.add_subplot(gs[0, i]) for i in range(3)]

for ax in axes:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")


def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, fc=LIGHT_GRAY, ec=GRAY, lw=1.0,
        fontsize=9.5, fontweight="normal", text_color=DARK,
        style="round,pad=0.12", multiline=False):
    patch = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle=style,
                           facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(patch)
    if multiline:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, text, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color,
                zorder=4, linespacing=1.3)
    else:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, text, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color,
                zorder=4)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, color=GRAY, lw=1.2, style="->",
        conn="arc3,rad=0", shrA=4, shrB=4):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle=style,
                        color=color, lw=lw, connectionstyle=conn,
                        shrinkA=shrA, shrinkB=shrB, zorder=5,
                        mutation_scale=11)
    ax.add_patch(a)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# (a) Formalization Pipeline — vertical flow
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[0]
ax.text(0.1, 9.7, "(a)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", va="top",
        color=DARK, family="sans-serif")
ax.text(5.0, 9.7, "Formalization Pipeline", fontsize=11.5,
        fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="top", color=DARK,
        family="sans-serif")

bw, bh = 5.6, 0.95
cx = 2.2
stages = [
    ("NL Premises + Conclusion", WHITE, GRAY),
    ("LLM Formalizer", LIGHT_BLUE, BLUE),
    ("Formal Program  $F$", WHITE, GRAY),
    ("Solver  $S$", LIGHT_GRAY, GRAY),
]
ys = [7.6, 5.9, 4.2, 2.3]

for i, (label, fc, ec) in enumerate(stages):
    lw = 1.5 if i == 1 else 1.0
    fw = "bold" if i == 1 else "normal"
    box(ax, cx, ys[i], bw, bh, label, fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw,
        fontsize=9.5, fontweight=fw)

for i in range(len(ys) - 1):
    arr(ax, cx + bw/2, ys[i], cx + bw/2, ys[i+1] + bh,
        color=GRAY, lw=1.3)

# Result fork
mid = cx + bw/2
box(ax, 0.8, 0.4, 3.2, 0.8, "Proved", fc="#E8F5E9", ec="#4CAF50",
    lw=1.0, fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", text_color="#2E7D32")
box(ax, 5.6, 0.4, 3.2, 0.8, "Failed", fc=LIGHT_RED, ec=RED,
    lw=1.0, fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", text_color=RED)

arr(ax, mid - 0.6, ys[3], 2.4, 1.2, color="#4CAF50", lw=1.2,
    conn="arc3,rad=0.12")
arr(ax, mid + 0.6, ys[3], 7.2, 1.2, color=RED, lw=1.2,
    conn="arc3,rad=-0.12")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# (b) STA Leave-One-Out — the core method
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[1]
ax.text(0.1, 9.7, "(b)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", va="top",
        color=DARK, family="sans-serif")
ax.text(5.2, 9.7, "Solver Trace Ablation", fontsize=11.5,
        fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="top", color=DARK,
        family="sans-serif")

# Top: proved formalization
box(ax, 0.5, 7.8, 9.0, 0.9,
    "Proved formalization  $F = \\{c_1, c_2, \\ldots, c_n\\}$",
    fc="#E8F5E9", ec="#4CAF50", lw=1.2, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold",
    text_color="#2E7D32")

# Component boxes
cw, ch = 0.85, 0.7
comp_x = [1.2, 2.5, 3.8, 5.1, 6.4, 7.7]
comp_labels = ["$c_1$", "$c_2$", "$c_3$", "$c_4$", r"$\cdots$", "$c_n$"]
cy = 6.6
for i, (lbl, x) in enumerate(zip(comp_labels, comp_x)):
    if r"\cdots" in lbl:
        ax.text(x + cw/2, cy + ch/2, r"$\cdots$", fontsize=12,
                ha="center", va="center", color=GRAY)
    else:
        box(ax, x, cy, cw, ch, lbl, fc=LIGHT_BLUE, ec=BLUE,
            lw=0.8, fontsize=9)

# LOO rows
ax.text(0.3, 5.75, "LOO test:", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color=DARK, va="center", family="sans-serif")

def draw_loo_row(ax, y, removed_idx, result_text, result_color, label):
    for i, x in enumerate(comp_x):
        if r"\cdots" in comp_labels[i]:
            ax.text(x + cw/2, y + ch/2, r"$\cdots$", fontsize=10,
                    ha="center", va="center", color=GRAY)
        elif i == removed_idx:
            box(ax, x, y, cw, ch, "", fc=LIGHT_RED, ec=RED, lw=0.8)
            ax.plot([x+0.1, x+cw-0.1], [y+0.1, y+ch-0.1],
                    color=RED, lw=1.5, zorder=5)
            ax.plot([x+0.1, x+cw-0.1], [y+ch-0.1, y+0.1],
                    color=RED, lw=1.5, zorder=5)
        else:
            box(ax, x, y, cw, ch, comp_labels[i], fc=LIGHT_BLUE, ec=BLUE,
                lw=0.6, fontsize=8.5)
    arr(ax, comp_x[-1] + cw + 0.15, y + ch/2,
        comp_x[-1] + cw + 0.7, y + ch/2, color=GRAY, lw=1.0)
    ax.text(comp_x[-1] + cw + 0.85, y + ch/2 + 0.15, result_text,
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", color=result_color, va="center")
    ax.text(comp_x[-1] + cw + 0.85, y + ch/2 - 0.22, label,
            fontsize=7.5, color=result_color, va="center", fontstyle="italic")

draw_loo_row(ax, 4.7, 0, "Fail", "#2E7D32", "necessary")
draw_loo_row(ax, 3.4, 1, "Prove", RED, "redundant")
draw_loo_row(ax, 2.1, 3, "Fail", "#2E7D32", "necessary")

# ISR formula
ax.text(5.0, 1.0,
        r"$\mathrm{ISR}(F) = \frac{|\{c_i : S(F\setminus\{c_i\}) = \mathrm{fail}\}|}{n}$",
        fontsize=12, ha="center", va="center", color=DARK,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.35", facecolor=WHITE,
                  edgecolor=BLUE, linewidth=1.2))


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# (c) ISR Dual Role — observe vs optimize
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[2]
ax.text(0.1, 9.7, "(c)", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", va="top",
        color=DARK, family="sans-serif")
ax.text(5.0, 9.7, "Observe vs. Optimize", fontsize=11.5,
        fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="top", color=DARK,
        family="sans-serif")

# ISR metric at top
box(ax, 2.0, 7.6, 6.0, 1.1, "ISR Metric", fc=WHITE, ec=DARK,
    lw=1.5, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

# Two branches
box(ax, 0.3, 4.8, 4.0, 1.6, "Post-hoc\nDiagnostic",
    fc="#E8F5E9", ec="#4CAF50", lw=1.2, fontsize=10.5,
    fontweight="bold", text_color="#2E7D32", multiline=True)

box(ax, 5.7, 4.8, 4.0, 1.6, "Training\nReward",
    fc=LIGHT_RED, ec=RED, lw=1.2, fontsize=10.5,
    fontweight="bold", text_color=RED, multiline=True)

# Fork arrows
arr(ax, 3.8, 7.6, 2.3, 6.4, color="#4CAF50", lw=1.5,
    conn="arc3,rad=0.12")
arr(ax, 6.2, 7.6, 7.7, 6.4, color=RED, lw=1.5,
    conn="arc3,rad=-0.12")

# Outcome arrows
arr(ax, 2.3, 4.8, 2.3, 3.6, color="#4CAF50", lw=1.2)
arr(ax, 7.7, 4.8, 7.7, 3.6, color=RED, lw=1.2)

# Outcomes
ax.text(2.3, 3.0, "Detects structural\ndegeneration",
        fontsize=8.5, ha="center", va="center", color="#2E7D32",
        linespacing=1.3,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="#E8F5E9",
                  edgecolor="#4CAF50", linewidth=0.6))

ax.text(7.7, 3.0, "Goodhart effect:\nTS achieves\nISR = 1",
        fontsize=8.5, ha="center", va="center", color=RED,
        linespacing=1.3,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor=LIGHT_RED,
                  edgecolor=RED, linewidth=0.6))

# Bottom labels with key insight
ax.text(2.3, 1.2, "Informative", fontsize=10, ha="center", va="center",
        fontweight="bold", color="#2E7D32")
ax.text(7.7, 1.2, "Gameable", fontsize=10, ha="center", va="center",
        fontweight="bold", color=RED)

# Asymmetry arrow
ax.annotate("", xy=(6.3, 0.35), xytext=(3.7, 0.35),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color=DARK, lw=1.3))
ax.text(5.0, 0.55, "Observe-vs-optimize\nasymmetry",
        fontsize=8, ha="center", va="center", color=DARK,
        fontweight="bold", fontstyle="italic", linespacing=1.2)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel dividers — thin solid lines
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.canvas.draw()
for i in range(2):
    bbox_r = axes[i].get_position()
    bbox_l = axes[i + 1].get_position()
    x_mid = (bbox_r.x1 + bbox_l.x0) / 2
    fig.add_artist(plt.Line2D([x_mid, x_mid], [0.06, 0.94],
                              transform=fig.transFigure,
                              color="#BDBDBD", linewidth=0.6, zorder=0))


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Save
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
base = "./fig1_sta_overview"
fig.savefig(base + ".pdf", format="pdf", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight",
            pad_inches=0.1)
fig.savefig(base + ".png", format="png", dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight",
            pad_inches=0.1)

print(f"Saved: {base}.pdf and .png")

]
ys = [7.6, 5.9, 4.2, 2.3]

for i, (label, fc, ec) in enumerate(stages):

for i in range(len(ys) - 1):

mid = cx + bw/2
box(ax, 0.8, 0.4, 3.2, 0.8, "Proved", fc="#E8F5E9", ec="#4CAF50",

box(ax, 5.6, 0.4, 3.2, 0.8, "Failed", fc=LIGHT_RED, ec=RED,

arr(ax, mid - 0.6, ys[3], 2.4, 1.2, color="#4CAF50", lw=1.2,

arr(ax, mid + 0.6, ys[3], 7.2, 1.2, color=RED, lw=1.2,

cy = 6.6
for i, (lbl, x) in enumerate(zip(comp_labels, comp_x)):
    if r"\cdots" in lbl:

ax.text(0.3, 5.75, "LOO test:", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",

def draw_loo_row(ax, y, removed_idx, result_text, result_color, label):

This is a three-panel academic methodology figure for a machine learning paper. The figure must be a clean, professional diagram with white background, no photographs, no 3D effects. Use only flat boxes, arrows, and text labels.

LAYOUT: Three panels arranged horizontally, separated by thin vertical lines. Each panel has a bold label (a), (b), (c) in top-left corner.

PANEL (a) — "Formalization Pipeline" (leftmost, narrower):
A simple vertical flowchart with 4 boxes connected by downward arrows:
Box 1 (top): "NL Premises + Conclusion" — white box with gray border
Box 2: "LLM Formalizer" — light blue box with blue border (this is the key step)
Box 3: "Formal Program F" — white box with gray border
Box 4: "Solver S" — light gray box
At the bottom, Box 4 forks into two outcomes:
- Left: "Proved" in a green box
- Right: "Failed" in a red box

PANEL (b) — "Solver Trace Ablation" (center, widest):
Shows a leave-one-out testing procedure:
- Top: A wide green box labeled "Proved formalization F = {c1, c2, ..., cn}"
- Below it: A row of small blue squares labeled c1, c2, c3, c4, ..., cn
- Then 3 test rows, each showing what happens when one component is removed:
  Row 1: c1 is crossed out (red X), others remain blue → arrow → "Fail (necessary)"
  Row 2: c2 is crossed out (red X), others remain blue → arrow → "Prove (redundant)"
  Row 3: c4 is crossed out (red X), others remain blue → arrow → "Fail (necessary)"
- Bottom: The ISR formula in a blue-bordered box: ISR(F) = |{ci : S(F\{ci}) = fail}| / n

PANEL (c) — "Observe vs. Optimize" (rightmost, narrower):
Shows the dual use of ISR metric:
- Top: "ISR Metric" in a prominent box with dark border
- It forks into two branches:
  Left (green): "Post-hoc Diagnostic" → "Detects structural degeneration" → checkmark, labeled "Informative"
  Right (red): "Training Reward" → "Goodhart effect: TS achieves ISR=1" → X mark, labeled "Gameable"
- Bottom: A double-headed arrow between the two sides labeled "Observe-optimize asymmetry"

STYLE: Academic paper quality. Serif font. Colors: blue (#2166AC), red (#B2182B), green (#4CAF50), gray (#636363). Clean, minimal, no gradients, no shadows, no decorative elements. Similar to figures in NeurIPS/ICML/ACL papers.

Solver Trace Ablation (STA) Overview — Three-Panel Figure

Panel (a): Formalization Pipeline
A vertical pipeline showing the process of neurosymbolic formalization:
1. "NL Premises + Conclusion" (input, white box) — natural language logical premises
2. Arrow down to "LLM Formalizer" (highlighted blue box) — the language model that translates NL to formal logic
3. Arrow down to "Formal Program F" (white box) — the resulting formal representation
4. Arrow down to "Solver S" (gray box) — external theorem prover (Prover9 or SWI-Prolog)
5. Fork at the bottom: left arrow to "Proved" (green) and right arrow to "Failed" (red)

Panel (b): STA Leave-One-Out Testing
The core diagnostic method. Shows:
- Top: A proved formalization F = {c₁, c₂, ..., cₙ} as a row of blue component boxes
- Below: Three LOO test rows showing what happens when one component is removed:
  - Row 1: c₁ removed (marked with X in red), remaining components shown → result: "Fail" (component is necessary)
  - Row 2: c₂ removed (marked with X in red), remaining components shown → result: "Prove" (component is redundant)
  - Row 3: c₄ removed (marked with X in red), remaining components shown → result: "Fail" (component is necessary)
- Bottom: The ISR formula in a bordered box: ISR(F) = |{cᵢ : S(F\{cᵢ}) = fail}| / n

Panel (c): Observe vs. Optimize Asymmetry
Shows the dual role of ISR and why it creates a Goodhart vulnerability:
- Top: "ISR Metric" box
- Left branch (green): "Post-hoc Diagnostic" → "Detects structural degeneration" → "Informative"
- Right branch (red): "Training Reward" → "Goodhart effect: TS achieves ISR = 1" → "Gameable"
- Bottom: Bidirectional arrow labeled "Observe-vs-optimize asymmetry" connecting the two outcomes

The figure illustrates that the same metric (ISR) that effectively diagnoses structural hacking when applied post-hoc becomes gameable when repurposed as a training reward, because tautological shortcuts (P→P) satisfy the necessity criterion by construction.

# Paper Banana — LLM 驱动的学术图表生成

PaperBanana 由 Gemini 自动写 matplotlib 代码，VLM Critic 评估渲染结果并迭代优化（默认 3 轮），输出 NeurIPS 风格 300 DPI 图表。

## 适用范围（与 paper-visualization.skill.md L4 路由一致）

| 场景 | 推荐工具 | 原因 |
|------|---------|------|
| **概念图**（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana** | matplotlib 手写 boxes/arrows/icons 极痛苦，LLM 生成代码更灵活 |
| **统计图**（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **matplotlib 手写** | 确定性、可控、有模板 |
| **探索性图**，不确定 layout | **PaperBanana** | LLM 多轮迭代试错 |
| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **matplotlib 手写** | 不依赖外部 API |

> **核心定位**：PaperBanana 的真正优势是**概念图**——这类图没有数据输入、是纯视觉布局，手写 matplotlib 代码极其繁琐。统计图有成熟模板（见 `draw-paper-figure.skill.md`），手写更可控。
>
> **与 draw-paper-figure 的区别**：draw-paper-figure 是手写模板（快、可控、确定性）；paper-banana 是 LLM 自动生成代码（慢、灵活、适合新图类型）。

## 前置条件：GOOGLE_API_KEY

```bash
# 检查 key 是否已配置
ssh_execute("echo $GOOGLE_API_KEY | head -c 10")

# 如未配置，需要用户提供 key，然后：
ssh_execute("echo 'export GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED]' >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc")

# 安装 PaperBanana
ssh_execute("pip install paperbanana -q")

# 验证安装
ssh_execute("paperbanana --version")
```

**⚠️ 如果 GOOGLE_API_KEY 未设置，直接停下来问用户要 key，不要尝试绕过。**

**⚠️ 中国大陆服务器访问 Gemini API 可能被墙。** 先测试连通性：`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`，超时则需设置代理或改用海外服务器。

## 用法一：概念图（主要用途）

概念图没有数据文件输入，靠 `--intent` 描述布局、组件、箭头、颜色语义。

```bash
# Framework / Pipeline 图
ssh_execute("""
cd ~/my-project && \
GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED] paperbanana plot \
  --intent "Three-stage pipeline diagram flowing left to right:
Stage 1 'Data Collection' (blue rounded box) with icons for web scraping and API,
Stage 2 'Processing' (green rounded box) with sub-steps filter/transform/validate stacked vertically,
Stage 3 'Model Training' (orange rounded box) with GPU icon.
Connect stages with thick arrows. Add a feedback loop arrow from Stage 3 back to Stage 1 (dashed, gray).
Below the pipeline, a horizontal bar showing 'Time: 2h → 6h → 24h'.
White background, no border, publication quality 300 DPI." \
  --iterations 3
""")

# 架构图（多组件 + 交互）
ssh_execute("""
cd ~/my-project && \
GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED] paperbanana plot \
  --intent "System architecture diagram:
Top layer: 'User Interface' (light blue rectangle, full width).
Middle layer: three equal boxes side by side — 'Auth Service', 'API Gateway', 'Cache' (all light green).
Bottom layer: two boxes — 'Database' (left, wider) and 'Message Queue' (right, narrower).
Vertical arrows connecting layers. Horizontal dashed arrow between Database and Message Queue.
Each box has a small icon in top-left corner. Rounded corners, drop shadow, white background." \
  --iterations 3
""")
```

### 概念图意图描述技巧

- **明确空间布局**：left-to-right / top-to-bottom / grid，不要让 LLM 猜
- **指定组件形状**：rounded box / circle / diamond / hexagon
- **颜色绑定语义**：和论文其他图一致（如 baseline=blue, treatment=orange）
- **箭头类型**：solid / dashed / thick / thin / bidirectional
- **标注所有文字**：每个 box 的 label、箭头上的 annotation

## 用法二：探索性统计图

已有模板的统计图（heatmap、scatter、bar）优先用 `draw-paper-figure`。PaperBanana 适合新图类型或不确定 layout 的探索。

```bash
# CSV 数据 + 意图描述
ssh_execute("""
cd ~/my-project && \
GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED] paperbanana plot \
  --data results/delta_ece_summary.csv \
  --intent "Diverging heatmap showing ΔECE (quantized minus FP16) for 4 PTQ methods across 6 datasets and 5 models, red=calibration degraded blue=improved, annotate significant cells with asterisk" \
  --iterations 3
""")

# JSON 数据
ssh_execute("""
cd ~/my-project && \
GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED] paperbanana plot \
  --data results/tstar_by_dataset.json \
  --intent "Line plot showing T* values across 6 datasets for 5 LLM models, highlight three regime zones with background shading"
""")
```

## 数据格式准备（统计图）

PaperBanana 接受 CSV（列名清晰）或 JSON（字典格式）：

```python
prep_script = """
import csv
data = [
    {'model': 'LLaMA-3.1-8B', 'method': 'GPTQ', 'dataset': 'ARC-C', 'delta_ece': -18.7, 'sig': True},
    {'model': 'LLaMA-3.1-8B', 'method': 'AWQ',  'dataset': 'TruthfulQA', 'delta_ece': +17.6, 'sig': False},
    # ... 完整数据
]
with open('results/summary.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['model','method','dataset','delta_ece','sig'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(data)
print("CSV ready")
"""
ssh_execute(f"cd ~/my-project && python3 -c '{prep_script}'")
```

## 输出处理

```bash
# 找最新生成的图
ssh_execute("""
latest=$(ls -td ~/my-project/outputs/run_*/ | head -1)
echo "Latest: $latest"
ls "$latest"
""")

# 复制到 figures/paper/ 并转 PDF
ssh_execute("""
latest=$(ls -td ~/my-project/outputs/run_*/ | head -1)
cp "$latest"/*.png ~/my-project/figures/paper/
cd ~/my-project/figures/paper/
for f in *.png; do
    python3 -c "
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.image as mpimg
img = mpimg.imread('$f')
h, w = img.shape[:2]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(w/300, h/300), dpi=300)
ax = fig.add_axes([0,0,1,1])
ax.imshow(img); ax.axis('off')
plt.savefig('${f%.png}.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0)
plt.close()
print('PDF:', '${f%.png}.pdf')
"
done
""")
```

## 迭代优化

```bash
# 查看 Critic 的评估反馈
ssh_execute("""
latest=$(ls -td ~/my-project/outputs/run_*/ | head -1)
cat "$latest/metadata.json" | python3 -m json.tool | grep -A5 "critic"
""")

# 重跑时加强意图描述（加更多约束）
ssh_execute("""
GOOGLE_API_KEY=[REDACTED] paperbanana plot \
  --intent "... [更具体的空间布局 / 颜色语义 / 组件关系描述] ..." \
  --iterations 5
""")
```

## 注意事项

- 每张图大约消耗 3-5 次 Gemini API 调用（3 轮迭代），Gemini free tier 够用
- 生成时间 1-3 分钟/图（含 LLM 调用 + 本地执行）
- 如果服务器无法访问 Gemini，改用 `draw-paper-figure`（完全离线）
- 概念图的 intent 描述越详细越好——空间布局、组件关系、颜色语义都要写清楚

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Fig 2: STA Overview — polished 3-panel academic figure (v3)."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

# ── Refined academic palette ──
BLUE      = "#2166AC"
LIGHT_BLUE = "#DAE8F5"
RED       = "#B2182B"
LIGHT_RED = "#F9E0D2"
GREEN     = "#2E7D32"
LIGHT_GREEN = "#E3F2E6"
GRAY      = "#555555"
MID_GRAY  = "#9E9E9E"
LIGHT_GRAY = "#F4F4F4"
BORDER    = "#BDBDBD"
DARK      = "#1A1A1A"
WHITE     = "#FFFFFF"
TEAL      = "#00796B"

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["CMU Serif", "DejaVu Serif", "Times New Roman"],
    "mathtext.fontset": "cm",
    "font.size": 10,
    "axes.linewidth": 0,
    "pdf.fonttype": 42,
    "ps.fonttype": 42,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14.5, 5.4))

gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 3, width_ratios=[0.85, 1.30, 0.85],
                      wspace=0.065, left=0.015, right=0.985,
                      top=0.94, bottom=0.02)
axes = [fig.add_subplot(gs[0, i]) for i in range(3)]

for ax in axes:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")


def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, fc=LIGHT_GRAY, ec=GRAY, lw=1.0,
        fontsize=9.5, fontweight="normal", text_color=DARK,
        style="round,pad=0.15", multiline=False, alpha=1.0):
    patch = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle=style,
                           facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
                           zorder=3, alpha=alpha)
    ax.add_patch(patch)
    kw = dict(ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize,
              fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color, zorder=4)
    if multiline:
        kw["linespacing"] = 1.4
    ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, text, **kw)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, color=GRAY, lw=1.2, style="-|>",
        conn="arc3,rad=0", shrA=5, shrB=5):
    a = FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle=style,
                        color=color, lw=lw, connectionstyle=conn,
                        shrinkA=shrA, shrinkB=shrB, zorder=5,
                        mutation_scale=12)
    ax.add_patch(a)


def panel_title(ax, label, title, x_title=5.0):
    ax.text(0.15, 9.7, label, fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", va="top",
            color=DARK, family="sans-serif")
    ax.text(x_title, 9.7, title, fontsize=11.5,
            fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="top", color=DARK,
            family="sans-serif")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# (a) Formalization Pipeline
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[0]
panel_title(ax, "(a)", "Formalization Pipeline")

bw, bh = 6.2, 1.0
cx = 1.9

# NL input with example
box(ax, cx, 7.8, bw, bh, "NL Premises + Conclusion",
    fc=WHITE, ec=BORDER, lw=1.0, fontsize=10)
ax.text(cx + bw/2, 7.15,
        r"$\it{e.g.}$  ``Every student takes a course.''",
        fontsize=7.5, ha="center", va="center", color=MID_GRAY,
        fontstyle="italic")

# LLM Formalizer (highlighted)
box(ax, cx, 5.7, bw, bh, "LLM Formalizer",
    fc=LIGHT_BLUE, ec=BLUE, lw=1.8, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold",
    text_color=BLUE)

# Formal program with example
box(ax, cx, 3.6, bw, bh, "Formal Program  $F$",
    fc=WHITE, ec=BORDER, lw=1.0, fontsize=10)
ax.text(cx + bw/2, 2.95,
        r"$\forall x\, (S(x) \to \exists y\, (C(y) \wedge T(x,y)))$",
        fontsize=8, ha="center", va="center", color=GRAY)

# Solver
box(ax, cx, 1.6, bw, bh, "Solver  $S$  (Prover9 / Prolog)",
    fc=LIGHT_GRAY, ec=GRAY, lw=1.0, fontsize=9.5, text_color=GRAY)

# Arrows between pipeline stages
for y_top, y_bot in [(7.8, 5.7+bh), (5.7, 3.6+bh), (3.6, 1.6+bh)]:
    arr(ax, cx+bw/2, y_top, cx+bw/2, y_bot, color=GRAY, lw=1.3)

# Result fork
mid = cx + bw/2
box(ax, 0.6, 0.0, 3.4, 0.75, "Proved",
    fc=LIGHT_GREEN, ec=GREEN, lw=1.0, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold",
    text_color=GREEN)
box(ax, 6.0, 0.0, 3.4, 0.75, "Failed",
    fc=LIGHT_RED, ec=RED, lw=1.0, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold",
    text_color=RED)

arr(ax, mid - 0.8, 1.6, 2.3, 0.75, color=GREEN, lw=1.3,
    conn="arc3,rad=0.15")
arr(ax, mid + 0.8, 1.6, 7.7, 0.75, color=RED, lw=1.3,
    conn="arc3,rad=-0.15")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# (b) STA Leave-One-Out
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[1]
panel_title(ax, "(b)", "Solver Trace Ablation", x_title=5.1)

# Proved formalization header
box(ax, 0.3, 8.15, 9.4, 0.85,
    r"Proved formalization  $F = \{c_1, c_2, \ldots, c_n\}$",
    fc=LIGHT_GREEN, ec=GREEN, lw=1.3, fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold",
    text_color=GREEN)

# Component boxes row
cw, ch = 0.95, 0.72
comp_x = [0.95, 2.30, 3.65, 5.00, 6.35, 7.70]
comp_labels = ["$c_1$", "$c_2$", "$c_3$", "$c_4$", r"$\cdots$", "$c_n$"]
cy = 7.0
for i, (lbl, x) in enumerate(zip(comp_labels, comp_x)):
    if r"\cdots" in lbl:
        ax.text(x + cw/2, cy + ch/2, r"$\cdots$", fontsize=13,
                ha="center", va="center", color=MID_GRAY)
    else:
        box(ax, x, cy, cw, ch, lbl, fc=LIGHT_BLUE, ec=BLUE,
            lw=0.9, fontsize=10, text_color=BLUE)

# LOO section label
ax.text(0.15, 5.7, "LOO", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color=DARK, va="center", ha="center", family="sans-serif")
ax.text(0.15, 5.25, "test", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color=DARK, va="center", ha="center", family="sans-serif")

# Draw a subtle bracket
ax.plot([0.55, 0.55], [4.45, 6.55], color=BORDER, lw=1.0, zorder=2)
ax.plot([0.50, 0.55], [6.55, 6.55], color=BORDER, lw=1.0, zorder=2)
ax.plot([0.50, 0.55], [4.45, 4.45], color=BORDER, lw=1.0, zorder=2)

def draw_loo_row(ax, y, removed_idx, result_text, result_color, label):
    for i, x in enumerate(comp_x):
        if r"\cdots" in comp_labels[i]:
            ax.text(x + cw/2, y + ch/2, r"$\cdots$", fontsize=11,
                    ha="center", va="center", color=MID_GRAY)
        elif i == removed_idx:
            box(ax, x, y, cw, ch, "", fc=LIGHT_RED, ec=RED, lw=1.0, alpha=0.7)
            # Elegant diagonal cross
            margin = 0.18
            ax.plot([x+margin, x+cw-margin], [y+margin, y+ch-margin],
                    color=RED, lw=2.2, zorder=6, solid_capstyle="round")
            ax.plot([x+margin, x+cw-margin], [y+ch-margin, y+margin],
                    color=RED, lw=2.2, zorder=6, solid_capstyle="round")
        else:
            box(ax, x, y, cw, ch, comp_labels[i], fc=LIGHT_BLUE, ec=BLUE,
                lw=0.6, fontsize=9, text_color=BLUE, alpha=0.85)

    # Solver re-run arrow
    x_end = comp_x[-1] + cw
    arr(ax, x_end + 0.12, y + ch/2,
        x_end + 0.65, y + ch/2, color=MID_GRAY, lw=1.0)
    ax.text(x_end + 0.72, y + ch/2, "$S$",
            fontsize=8, color=MID_GRAY, va="center", ha="left")
    arr(ax, x_end + 0.95, y + ch/2,
        x_end + 1.25, y + ch/2, color=MID_GRAY, lw=1.0)

    # Result
    ax.text(x_end + 1.45, y + ch/2 + 0.12, result_text,
            fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", color=result_color, va="center")
    ax.text(x_end + 1.45, y + ch/2 - 0.25, label,
            fontsize=7.5, color=result_color, va="center", fontstyle="italic")

draw_loo_row(ax, 5.85, 0, "fail", GREEN, "necessary")
draw_loo_row(ax, 4.65, 1, "prove", RED, "redundant")
draw_loo_row(ax, 3.45, 3, "fail", GREEN, "necessary")

# Brace/summary: n_necessary / n
ax.plot([0.55, 0.55], [2.4, 3.2], color=BORDER, lw=0.8, zorder=2)
ax.annotate("", xy=(1.0, 2.6), xytext=(0.55, 2.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=BORDER, lw=0.8))

ax.text(1.2, 2.55, r"$n_{\mathrm{nec}}$ of $n$",
        fontsize=8.5, color=GRAY, va="center")

# ISR formula — centered, prominent
box(ax, 1.5, 0.75, 7.0, 1.3, "",
    fc=WHITE, ec=BLUE, lw=1.5, style="round,pad=0.2")
ax.text(5.0, 1.4,
        r"$\mathrm{ISR}(F) \;=\; \frac{|\{c_i : S(F\!\setminus\!\{c_i\}) = \mathrm{fail}\}|}{n}$",
        fontsize=14, ha="center", va="center", color=DARK)
ax.text(5.0, 0.95,
        "fraction of individually necessary components",
        fontsize=7.5, ha="center", va="center", color=MID_GRAY,
        fontstyle="italic")

# Arrow from LOO summary to ISR
arr(ax, 2.0, 2.4, 3.5, 2.05, color=MID_GRAY, lw=0.9,
    style="-|>", conn="arc3,rad=-0.1")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# (c) ISR Dual Role — Observe vs Optimize
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[2]
panel_title(ax, "(c)", "Observe vs. Optimize")

# ISR metric at top
box(ax, 1.5, 8.0, 7.0, 1.1, "ISR Metric", fc=WHITE, ec=DARK,
    lw=1.8, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")

# Section references

        ha="center", va="center", fontweight="bold")

        ha="center", va="center", fontweight="bold")

# Fork arrows

    conn="arc3,rad=0.12")

    conn="arc3,rad=-0.12")

# Two role boxes

    fc=LIGHT_GREEN, ec=GREEN, lw=1.3, fontsize=11,
